hypothesis: The pinned public converter deterministically reproduces selected EXL3 payloads, resumes from an interrupted suffix without byte drift, and passes the publication finalizer.
falsifier: A/A payload divergence, panel reconstruction failure, resume mismatch, non-atomic finalization, or identity mismatch rejects converter qualification.

decision_rules.accept: All four converter controls pass with immutable identities.
decision_rules.reject: Any deterministic or finalizer control fails.
decision_rules.futility: Stop the converter-derived lane after a confirmed deterministic failure.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on OOM, source mutation, insufficient reserve, or only-copy risk.
